Hysteria2 client engine bundled with LocalDeck
================================================

Project: Hysteria
Upstream: https://github.com/HyNetworks/hysteria
Legacy URL: https://github.com/apernet/hysteria
Version: app/v2.13.0
Commit: ca8fbd874fd6ca82413948de6dc5924405e103e1
Artifact: hysteria-windows-amd64.exe
Upstream artifact SHA256:
162ef8fe55dc7ec810dda662908f8e65ec36bd6da39cb87c3bd66184ab68f067
License: MIT, see LICENSE.md

LocalDeck runs this binary only in client mode with update checks disabled. The
binary listens on a dynamically allocated 127.0.0.1 SOCKS5 port and is stopped
when the LocalDeck proxy stops. It is not installed system-wide and does not
replace the existing mixed HTTP/SOCKS5 proxy or routing rules.

The official artifact hash was verified against the upstream release
hashes.txt before it was added to this repository.
